audit_label_review.selection: Lowest SHA-256 of stage4a-label-review:<example_id> in audit partition, before scores; retain labels, report ambiguity.

evaluation: Report all eligible audit rows, per-source metrics, class counts, balanced accuracy, confusion, precision/recall/F1/FPR and exclusions.
Record model/dataset/protocol digests and local text-free predictions.
Independent group bootstrap, 1000 resamples, seed 42, percentile 95% intervals; intervals do not address source bias or label errors.
The audit cohort becomes development evidence after inspection. Keep reserve unscored and require a new precommitted protocol before any future final use.

external_split.rule: Deterministic whole-group allocation minimizing class-wise squared target deviation; reserve never scored or manually reviewed. Preparation reads it only for quality, language and grouping.

internal_diagnostics: Rescore frozen train/validation/test, compare published test counts.
Recheck declared grouping at 0.90 and exploratory broader similarity at 0.70; report cross-split relations without modifying data.
Report coefficients and training document frequencies for 12 top terms per direction; coefficients are associations, not causal explanations.
Count fixed text-pattern indicators by label; no feature removal or retuning based on outcomes.
protocol.mime: Parse offline. Decode subject and select inline plain text, falling back to HTML text. Ignore attachments and embedded messages, script/style/head/noscript and comments; do not follow links or execute/render HTML. Strict declared charset decoding; fallback UTF-8 replacement is excluded if replacement characters remain. Remove repeated leading [SPAM]/[PHISHING] subject flags. Reject unusable/overlong text rather than truncate.
protocol.model_policy: Load the exact stage-3 baseline and threshold. No fitting, feature/threshold tuning or stage-5 work. Do not evaluate the stage-4 pretrained model in this audit.

relatedness.closure: transitive components; exact duplicate inputs collapsed, conflicting exact labels excluded. Entire external components touching ANY internal train/validation/test row excluded.
relatedness.exact: canonical preprocessed subject/body; exact body at least 20 characters
relatedness.subject: casefold/whitespace, remove leading Re/Fw/Fwd prefixes; at least 15 characters and 3 words
relatedness.template: remove complete synthetic markers; mask square placeholders, URLs, email addresses and digits

limits: Sources and eras differ by label; this is a cross-source stress test, not a contemporary-inbox prevalence sample.
Nazario represents one personal inbox with hand labels that may contain errors. Ham means publisher non-spam, not independently authenticated safe mail.
MIME text extraction cannot assess attachments, images, sender identity or destinations.
Language identification and heuristic grouping may make mistakes.
